categories.label: Patient details
categories.scope: Date of birth, sex and other explicitly recorded identity attributes

categories.label: Encounters
categories.scope: Admission/discharge events, departments and reasons for encounters

categories.label: Diagnoses
categories.scope: Confirmed, suspected and negated conditions with status

categories.label: Symptoms and episodes
categories.scope: Symptoms, onset, course and explicitly documented causal attribution

categories.label: Allergies and reactions
categories.scope: Substances, recorded reactions and explicit negative allergy statements

categories.label: Medications
categories.scope: Drug, strength, administered dose, route, schedule and prescription context

categories.label: Vitals and anthropometrics
categories.scope: Weight, height, blood pressure components, pulse and temperature

categories.label: Laboratory findings
categories.scope: Numerical tests and qualitative laboratory findings

categories.label: Imaging findings
categories.scope: Findings, anatomical site and laterality; examination itself is a procedure

categories.label: Functional assessments
categories.scope: Ejection fraction, rhythm, cognitive or other functional assessments

categories.label: Pathology and tumour characteristics
categories.scope: Histology, staging, grade, receptors and proliferation markers

categories.label: Procedures and investigations
categories.scope: Performed or explicitly not-performed investigations/interventions; negation does not establish completion. Recommended/planned interventions belong to care_plans

categories.label: Care plans
categories.scope: Recommended or scheduled interventions, timing and responsible service

categories.label: Follow-up recommendations
categories.scope: Recommended reviews/checks and separately evidenced completion events

categories.label: Medical and surgical history
categories.scope: Explicit historical context and prior operations

categories.label: Family history
categories.scope: Conditions and negative history concerning relatives, not the patient

categories.label: Social history and support
categories.scope: Documented living situation, support, smoking and alcohol history

categories.label: Other clinical information
categories.scope: Supported clinical information not yet covered; retain specific concept and wording
